requirement.statement: The organization-adjustment bundle SHALL model stable organization/person identities, typed valid/recorded temporal facts, ordered adjustment commands and append-only audit evidence through Property-first Kon declarations; expose exact timeline-aware presets and registered operations for snapshot, history, compare, preview, validate, workflow transitions, atomic apply and independent transfer batch; and permit relational writes only through one private OrganizationAdjustmentWriter while every execute request remains fresh and deterministic.

case.when: the public runtime compiler projects it
case.then: all eight entities and typed navigation relations SHALL compile; foreign-key Fields SHALL contain only physical metadata and every temporal fact SHALL expose valid/recorded half-open bounds

case.when: snapshot, history and compare operations execute with day timelines
case.then: the returned tree/table/composite outcomes SHALL derive deterministic unit, hierarchy and primary-assignment changes from temporal rows without projection writes

case.given: a draft adjustment and its effective day
case.then: both SHALL load facts outside and use the same context-free candidate-state validator over the complete current-recorded timeline, reject malformed valid/recorded bounds and dangling temporal identity references, return structured projected changes or constraint facts including future overlaps, and perform zero Writer calls

case.given: DRAFT, VALIDATED and APPROVED seeded adjustments
case.when: MarkValidated, Approve and Apply run through their registered refs
case.then: MarkValidated SHALL run the shared validator before its atomic transition; only legal transitions SHALL occur; Apply SHALL revalidate after its transaction starts and atomically commit temporal replacements, one audit event and APPLIED status through the private writer

case.given: replacement facts whose current-recorded valid intervals overlap for the same temporal identity
case.when: Validate, MarkValidated or transaction-time Apply validation runs
case.then: the result SHALL identify TEMPORAL_INTERVAL_OVERLAP and every write-capable execution SHALL leave status, facts and audit unchanged

case.given: a Person would have more than one active primary assignment on the same business day
case.when: Validate, MarkValidated or transaction-time Apply validation runs
case.then: the result SHALL identify MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_ASSIGNMENTS independently of temporal interval overlap and every write-capable execution SHALL leave status, facts and audit unchanged

case.given: cycle, missing-target, illegal-state and injected post-replacement failure scenarios
case.then: stable failures SHALL preserve the violated invariant code and request path through the runtime response, and no failed atomic execution SHALL leave temporal, audit or status changes

case.given: create-unit and close-unit adjustment commands at an effective day
case.when: Preview, Validate or Apply projects or commits the commands
case.then: create-unit SHALL require a stable parent identity with exactly one visible ACTIVE version, close-unit SHALL reject unresolved active children or primary assignments, and successful close SHALL end every owned unit-version and hierarchy period without deleting recorded history

case.given: independently keyed Person transfer items including invalid targets or repeated subjects
case.then: every item SHALL pass the same complete current-recorded candidate-state validator before Writer access; every successful item SHALL materialize one adjustment through DRAFT, VALIDATED, APPROVED and APPLIED; atomic SHALL roll back all items after a failure while best-effort SHALL retain valid siblings and remap structured diagnostics; and the atomicity choice SHALL NOT change business validity or final facts when every item succeeds

case.given: the same write preset invoked sequentially or concurrently
case.then: each call SHALL start from equivalent seed, produce deterministic facts, use an independent execution id and destroy its SQLite state
